title: Mapping the Afterlife of Future Work Statements in NLP Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.18847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Future work statements are one of the few places in scientific papers where authors explicitly describe what they think should happen next. We study what happens to such statements after publication. We construct a dataset of 72,070 future work items extracted from 23,113 ACL Anthology papers published between 1979 and 2025, categorize them by type, retrieve candidate follow-up papers through citation-based and content-based search, and use LLM-based judgments to assess whether later papers pursue the proposed directions. Using this resource, we analyze patterns across time, venues, categories, themes, and authors. We find that many items are later addressed, often within a few years, with clear differences across types and themes and a largely community-driven pattern. translated_title: 绘制NLP研究中“未来工作”陈述的后续命运图谱
translated_abstract: 未来工作陈述是科学论文中少数几个作者明确描述他们认为下一步研究应当如何开展的地方。我们研究了这类陈述在论文发表后的去向。我们构建了一个包含72,070条未来工作条目的数据集，这些条目提取自1979年至2025年间发表的23,113篇ACL Anthology论文；我们按类型对这些条目进行分类，通过基于引用和基于内容的检索获取候选后续论文，并使用基于大语言模型的判断来评估后续论文是否落实了所提出的方向。利用这一资源，我们分析了跨时间、会议、类别、主题和作者的模式。我们发现许多条目在后续研究中得到了落实，且往往发生在几年之内，不同类型和主题之间存在明显差异，整体呈现出主要由社区驱动的模式。我们的结果表明，未来工作陈述为研究NLP领域研究方向的发展提供了有用的证据。为支持进一步研究，我们发布了数据集。
tldr: 该研究构建了包含72,070条未来工作陈述的大规模数据集，通过引用与内容检索结合大语言模型判断，首次系统追踪并揭示了NLP论文中作者提出的未来研究方向被后续研究落实的模式与规律。
en_tdlr: This study builds a large-scale dataset of 72,070 future work statements from NLP papers and, using citation/content-based retrieval with LLM-based judgments, systematically traces how these proposed research directions are later pursued, revealing community-driven patterns in how NLP research evolves.
